The vendor directly providing the software platform and services at **bazaarvoice.com** is **Bazaarvoice, Inc.**.

### Evidence
* According to the official [Bazaarvoice Privacy Policy](https://www.bazaarvoice.com/legal/privacy-policy/): 
  > *"This Privacy Policy is intended to inform you... about **Bazaarvoice, Inc.**, its affiliates' and subsidiaries' ('Bazaarvoice', 'we', 'us', or 'our') collection, use, security and disclosure of information that we receive through the services that we provide... through **bazaarvoice.com**, and/or other Bazaarvoice-branded websites ('Website'), and through the business applications offered to our direct Clients on the Website ('BizApps') (collectively, the 'Services')."*
* The [Bazaarvoice API Terms of Use](https://www.bazaarvoice.com/legal/api-terms-of-use/) likewise state: 
  > *"Thank you for using the **Bazaarvoice, Inc.** ('we', 'our' or 'Bazaarvoice') application programming interface..."*
